summary: Every graph node the API returns (GET /api/v1/references node, edges[].node, edges[].block; GET /api/v1/block-links from, to, links[].from, links[].to) gains made_by, made_at, changed_by, changed_at (on every kind, keeping the block meaning), parent {kind,id,ref?} and parent_version, for issue, artifact, document block, ask, comment, message, component and session; dispatch read prints a Node: line. Recorded from this change on: comments/asks.written_version (before-insert trigger + backfill migration) and component_facts (importer upsert). Proven by Go store/API/importer tests, the CLI Bun tests and an R12 section of packages/dispatch/e2e/acceptance/block-graph.sh on the local harness; production run after the close.

decisions: What counts as a change is the node's own edit route: issue PATCH (issue.created/updated/closed), ask wording edits (ask.edited), comment body edits; claims, answers, resolutions and suggestion decisions do not move changed_*
An approval ask's parent is the document it asks a person to approve (approval.artifact_id), at the version it named when opened

Unanchored document comments and asks record written_version at insert from this release on (a before-insert trigger, so the earlier build's inserts during the roll are recorded); older rows are backfilled from the ask.opened event (approval asks) or by timestamp
A block's maker is the first version that held it when Dispatch knows it (F = 1, or version F-1 indexed); otherwise empty
Component made_at/changed_at are recorded from this release on in component_facts; existing components answer null until they change; made_by/changed_by stay empty
parent.id is the parent node's own id (an artifact's uuid), not its ref_key as the tree plan's test had it
dispatch read prints the Node: line for the node it reads; edge rows keep their shape

findings.finding: A block's maker from min(document_block_texts.version) is wrong for blocks that existed before indexing (indexOwedDocument indexes the latest version only, docs/block_index.go:316-326)
findings.answer: Design 2: maker known only when F = 1 or version F-1 is indexed; else made_by [] and made_at null; TestABlockSeenFirstAtItsDocumentsFirstIndexingHasNoMaker

findings.finding: The unanchored item version guessed from timestamps races, and the claim that the census forbids backfills is false (0089)
findings.answer: Design 3: written_version recorded at insert by a before-insert trigger; a 0089-style backfill migration for older rows (ask.opened event for approval asks, timestamp for the rest); store migration tests

findings.finding: The approval-ask parent rule contradicted itself; an issue-document approval ask has artifact_id null (api/reviews.go:478-480, api/owner.go:43-46)
findings.answer: Decision 2: approval.artifact_id at the version named at opening, on issue and project documents alike

findings.finding: 'Own text or fields' was ambiguous (claims, resolutions, ask state)
findings.answer: Design 1 rule: the node's own edit route, citing R12's answer example and the prior art's 'last edited'; TestAChangeMovesOnlyTheChangedNode

findings.finding: Facts of a pinned block node were undefined; the removed node needs its own queries
findings.answer: Design 2: current pin = the current block's facts; removed pin = first version's maker, removing version's change, parent_version the last indexed version before removal; TestAPinnedBlockCarriesItsFacts; driver check on $pin

findings.finding: 'dispatch read prints them' was underspecified: graphEdges drops the node, the block read builds its own head, no component/session read, DM thread has no graph
findings.answer: Design 5: exact Node: line format, printed by graphSections and the block read; Bun tests for each read path and the older-server case; component and session read through the API

findings.finding: The driver's acceptance needed exact per-kind expectations; the tree plan's helpers do not exist; session reachable only via followed_by; comment edits need a human
findings.answer: Task 5: exact jq projections with the driver's own helpers; session via ?from=<ask>&kind=followed_by; comment changed_* proven in Go tests

findings.finding: Driver surfaces missed edges[].block and block-links
findings.answer: Task 5 and TestTheFactsOfAnEdgesOtherEndAreTheNodesOwn compare edges[].block and every block-links node with the node's own ?to= read

findings.finding: Component harness facts were wrong (FAKE_GITHUB_PORT, PUT /__fixture/repos); UNAVAILABLE breaks the driver's PASS/FAIL contract
findings.answer: COMPONENT_SOURCE=fixture|existing|none, each a PASS or FAIL; the trap deletes the source; production checked with none (GET /api/v1/settings/architecture-sources answered [] on 2026-10-27)

findings.finding: component_facts gaps: re-added components, digest fields, earlier-build imports, made_by
findings.answer: Design 4: orphan delete in the import and the source delete handler, digest fields named, roll behaviour stated, made_by empty with reason; importer test

findings.finding: The driver leaves an open ask visible to people in production
findings.answer: Task 5: the driver resolves its ask before closing and in the trap

findings.finding: No coordination with the root issue's concurrent PR or migration numbers
findings.answer: Task 0 Envoy message; numbers follow main's head, the second to merge renumbers

findings.finding: Event lookups risk slow reads; the partial index needs its exact type list
findings.answer: Task 2: lateral limit-1 per key, batched per loader, the ask statement repeats 0030's type list; EXPLAIN recorded in the implementer's handoff

findings.finding: A block ask's version source was open
findings.answer: Design 2: F of its block by the same rule; TestABlockAskBelongsToTheVersionThatAddedIt

findings.finding: Parent references need loader joins; a component parent may name a missing component
findings.answer: Design 1 'Parent references' lists the joins; a missing parent component gives parent null
